Mean of the distribution = 24.6

Concept used:

(Sum of the products of mid values and the frequencies) ÷ (sum of the frequencies) = Mean of the distribution

Calculation:

According to the question,

(6 × 5 + 12 × 15 + 15 × 25 + x × 35 + 5 × 45)/(6 + 12 + 15 + x + 5) = 24.6

⇒ (810 + 35x)/(38 + x) = 24.6

⇒ 810 + 35x = 934.8 + 24.6x

⇒ 10.4x = 124.8

⇒ x = 12

**∴ The value of x is 12.**
